company.name: Rentomojo
company.summary: Furniture and appliance rentals that help people furnish a home through monthly payments.
company.description: Rentomojo supplies furniture, home appliances and furnishing packages on rental plans. Customers choose products and a tenure, while delivery, installation, maintenance and return logistics support the rental service. The business must keep its inventory earning across successive customers.
company.ownership: This profile covers Rentomojo Limited, formerly Edunetwork and Rentomojo Private Limited. Renting an appliance through its platform does not mean Rentomojo manufactures that appliance brand.
company.money: Recurring rental payments are the core revenue stream. Inventory purchases, financing, repairs, delivery and collection costs affect how much profit remains. A product sitting unused still ties up cash.
watch: How much of the available furniture and appliance stock is on rent?
Do rental receipts cover purchase, repairs, funding and delivery over the asset’s useful life?
Do customers renew, and how expensive is it to acquire their replacements?
risks: Returns, wear and damage can reduce the income earned from an item.
Buying inventory before collecting months of rent can require substantial capital.
Relocation, failed collections and late payments can raise operating costs.
company.question: Why is a rented refrigerator sitting in a warehouse a business issue?
company.answer: It has used cash and may still incur financing and storage costs, but earns no rental income until it reaches a paying customer.
update: Compare rental receipts with asset utilisation and the costs of funding and maintaining inventory. This profile does not display live rental prices.
company.productNote: Major offering families reviewed on 27 October 2026. Variants, locations and individual models are grouped; availability can vary.
